data.name: Bidhan
data.long_meaning: Bidhan is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'vidhana', meaning 'wise' or 'intelligent'. In Hindu mythology, Bidhan is revered as a name of Lord Vishnu, the preserver deity, signifying wisdom and knowledge. This name is believed to bestow upon the child a sharp intellect and a deep understanding of the world.
